name: slopocop
description: Slop cop for text — detects AI slop and humanizes it in Russian and English. Two knowledge-base skills (humanizer-ru: 54 patterns + hard bans + fact-lock + a deterministic 0-100 scanner; slop-humanizer: EN de-slop synthesized from 5 humanizer repos), two commands (/slop-audit read-only detection, /slop-humanize full rewrite with language auto-routing), a hook-triggered slop-cop reviewer agent, and a PostToolUse hint on text files. Use when humanizing text, removing AI tells, de-slopping, or auditing prose before publishing. Design/animation slop is out of scope by design (split from antislop).
